anonymizationBatch.title: Anonymisation Batch
anonymizationBatch.description: State of one multi-file anonymisation run: which documents it covers, how far each of them got, and which phase the batch as a whole is in. The batch flow spans several HTTP requests (create -> extract -> review -> anonymise -> report), so this record is what carries it between them. It was previously held only in Nextcloud's distributed cache, which degrades to a NullCache on any instance without `memcache.local` configured — the record was discarded on write and every follow-up call on the batch answered 404. Written and read exclusively by BatchStateRepository, keyed by the batch UUID (the object UUID is the batchId). Ownership is enforced in BatchStateService::getBatch(), which refuses a batch belonging to another non-admin user.

batchId.description: Batch identifier. Mirrors the object UUID so the record is self-describing when inspected in OpenRegister.
batchId.title: Batch ID

userId.description: Nextcloud user ID that owns the batch. BatchStateService refuses a read by any other non-admin user. maxLength is 255, not 64: measured on the dev instance, OpenRegister enforces `required`, `enum` and property constraints EVEN WHEN `hardValidation` is false, so a long externally-provisioned uid over the limit would fail the batch write closed, which is the exact failure mode this schema exists to remove.
userId.title: Owner

Time-bound (validFrom / validUntil) and rule-typed (exact / normalized / bsn / kvk) so the cache can resolve a match in O(1) per entity.

get.description: Get a single signing request by id, including its status, eIDAS level and deadline. Returns no signature material.

DRAFT.label: Draft
DRAFT.description: Signing request is being assembled by the initiator; not yet sent to signers.

PENDING.label: Pending
PENDING.description: Request has been sent and is awaiting signer action.

IN_PROGRESS.label: In progress
IN_PROGRESS.description: At least one signer has started; the request is being signed.

COMPLETED.label: Completed
COMPLETED.description: All signers have signed. Terminal state.

DECLINED.label: Declined
DECLINED.description: A signer declined; the request is terminated. Terminal.

EXPIRED.label: Expired
EXPIRED.description: The deadline passed before completion. Terminal.

CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
CANCELLED.description: The initiator cancelled the request. Terminal.

send.label: Send for signing
send.description: Notify the configured signers and start collecting signatures.

start.label: Start signing
start.description: A signer has opened the request; mark the request as in progress.

complete.label: Complete signing
complete.description: All signers have signed; finalise the request. Terminal.

decline.label: Decline
decline.description: A signer declined; terminate the request. Terminal.

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.description: Initiator cancels the request before completion. Terminal.

documentVersion.title: Document version
documentVersion.description: The finalisation record of one version of a document. A version is draft or final. Final records who made it final, when, why, and the checksum of the file at that moment. This schema holds no file content and no version history: the bytes stay in Nextcloud files_versions, which document-versions keeps as the only version store.

fileId.description: Nextcloud file id of the document this version belongs to.
fileId.title: File ID

versionLabel.description: The files_versions label this record is about. Empty means the current content.
versionLabel.title: Version label

documentName.description: Name of the document when the record was written.
documentName.title: Document name

status.description: Draft or final. Final is terminal: a final version accepts no write and no way back.
status.title: Status

finalisedBy.description: User id of the person who made this version final.
finalisedBy.title: Finalised by

finalisedByName.description: Display name of that person at the moment of finalisation.
finalisedByName.title: Finalised by name

finalReason.description: The reason or the act that made this version final, such as the decision that was taken.
finalReason.title: Reason

supersedes.description: UUID of the final version this one corrects. The superseded version stays readable and stays final.
supersedes.title: Supersedes

supersededBy.description: UUID of the version that corrects this one, written on the predecessor so a reader of either sees the chain.
supersededBy.title: Superseded by

fileChecksum.description: sha256 of the file at the moment it became final. A later mismatch means the file changed outside Filinq.
fileChecksum.title: File checksum

unfrozen.description: True once an administrator has unfrozen this version. The mark is permanent and cannot be cleared.
unfrozen.title: Unfrozen

unfrozenBy.description: User id of the administrator who unfroze this version.
unfrozenBy.title: Unfrozen by

unfrozenReason.description: Why the administrator unfroze this version. Required when unfreezing.
unfrozenReason.title: Unfreeze reason

finalise.label: Definitief maken
finalise.description: De versie is definitief. Wie, wanneer, waarom en de checksum worden vastgelegd. Er is geen overgang terug: een correctie is een nieuwe versie.

documentFinalityRule.title: Document finality rule
documentFinalityRule.description: A declaration by a consuming app that certain states of one of its record types make that type's documents final. Filinq stores the declaration against the type reference and applies it when the state changes. Filinq does not define the record type vocabulary: dossiq owns its case types and result types, and this schema only records what that app declared.

declaringApp.description: App id of the consuming app that made the declaration, such as dossiq.
declaringApp.title: Declaring app

typeReference.description: The consuming app's own reference for the record type, such as a case type or result type id.
typeReference.title: Type reference

finalStates.description: The states of that record type that make its documents final.
finalStates.title: Final states

documentRole.description: Which document of the record the rule applies to, such as besluit. Empty means every document of the record.
documentRole.title: Document role

reasonTemplate.description: The reason written on the version when this rule fires. Empty means the transition itself is the reason.
reasonTemplate.title: Reason template

declaredBy.description: User id that stored the declaration.
declaredBy.title: Declared by
